ui.run.node.combate.help: Regular fight. On a win: gold and a reward (item, weapon or extra).
ui.run.node.elite.help: Hard fight against an elite. More gold and sometimes a branch ULT.
ui.run.node.jefe.help: The floor''s guardian. Defeat it to move on to the next floor.
ui.run.node.tienda.help: Buy weapons for your class, potions and Ether with gold; sell what you do not need.
ui.run.node.armeria.help: Upgrade your weapons with gold (forge) and move skills between weapons (fusion).
ui.run.map.click_to_vote: Click to vote for this path.
ui.run.prep.meta: Echoes: {coins} · Journeys: {runs} ({wins} won) · Zones in the draw: {zones}
ui.run.prep.difficulty_hint: Each level adds HP and attack to enemies. Win on the highest one to unlock the next.
ui.run.prep.loadout_hint: Added to your weapon''s skills for the whole Journey.
ui.run.attr.vit.name: Vitality
ui.run.attr.fue.name: Strength
ui.run.attr.esp.name: Spirit
ui.run.attr.des.name: Dexterity
ui.run.attr.agi.name: Agility
ui.run.attr.fue.help: More ATK with weapons that scale with Strength.
ui.run.attr.esp.help: More max MP and MAG with magic weapons.
ui.run.attr.des.help: More ATK with Dexterity weapons and more crit.
ui.run.character.title: CHARACTER
ui.run.character.attr_base: Class base {n}. Only raised by attribute rewards.
ui.run.character.weapon_hint: Upgraded at the armory (FORGE), along with its skills.
ui.run.character.skills_hint: Besides ATTACK, DEFEND and the weapon''s. Cap {max} counting ATTACK and DEFEND.
ui.run.character.no_room: No room: store another one first
ui.run.character.bag_line: {weapons} {weapons, plural, one{weapon} other{weapons}} · Potions {potions} · Ether {ethers} · Gold ₵{gold}
ui.run.character.no_boons: You have not taken any yet.
ui.run.character.boon_hint: Lasts the whole run; stacks if you take it again.
ui.run.character.no_items: You have not taken any yet.
ui.run.open_character_tip: Attributes, weapon, ULT, boons and run items
ui.run.open_inventory_tip: Equip weapons, use potions and sort the bag
ui.run.lobby.title: JOURNEY
ui.run.lobby.about: Three floors, a branching path and a guardian at the end of each. Everyone starts with a fresh character of their class: what you earn in the run is lost when it ends. In CHARACTER you can equip your weapon and pick your ULT before setting out.
ui.run.lobby.has_save: There is a Journey in progress. You can resume it where you left off or abandon it to start another.
ui.run.map.pick_next: Mark the next node. Waiting for: {names}
ui.run.stop.shop: Weapons for your class, ULTs, potions and Ether for gold. Sell what you do not use at the same shop.
ui.run.stop.armory: Upgrade your weapons with gold (FORGE: power, crit, speed) or move a skill from one weapon to another (FUSION).
ui.run.stop.rest: The group rests and recovers HP and MP.
ui.run.forge.title: UPGRADE SKILLS
ui.run.forge.hint: The weapon (and what it brings) is upgraded in OPEN FORGE → UPGRADE. Here, each level adds +{pct} % power to a free skill (up to +{max}).
ui.run.forge.none: You have no free skills to upgrade.
ui.run.ult_shop.title: ULTS FOR SALE
ui.run.over.summary: Floor reached: {floor}/{floors} · Fights won: {wins} · Echoes earned: {coins}
ui.run.reward.help.habilidad: Free skill: equipped apart from the weapon''s. If there is no room, you have to sacrifice one.
ui.run.reward.help.oro: For the shop and the armory forge.
ui.run.reward.help.pocion: Each potion heals HP in or out of combat.
ui.run.reward.help.eter: Each Ether restores MP in combat.
ui.run.reward.help.atributo: Raises {attr} for the rest of the run. {help}
ui.run.reward.help.mejora: Direct boon: lasts the whole run and stacks if you take it again. Shown in BOONS, in CHARACTER.
ui.run.reward.drop.title: YOU HAVE TO SACRIFICE A SKILL
ui.run.reward.drop.text: No room for {name}. Pick which one to drop (the weapon''s are not touched).
ui.run.reward.title: CHOOSE YOUR REWARD
ui.run.reward.row.items_help: Run items: a passive effect that lasts until the end of the Journey.
ui.run.reward.row.items_tip: Added to RUN ITEMS in CHARACTER.
ui.run.reward.row.weapon_help: Goes to the bag; equips with no minimum level or attributes.
ui.run.reward.row.ult_help: Rare and valuable: stays learned and active; change it in CHARACTER.
ui.run.reward.row.extra_help: Gold, consumables, attributes, a direct boon or a skill.
